messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets.
Your doctor may occasionally change your dose.
Use the medicine exactly as directed.
Take empagliflozin once a day in the morning, with or without food.
Your blood sugar will need to be checked often.
You may also need to test the level of ketones in your urine.
Empagliflozin can cause life-threatening ketoacidosis (too much acid in the blood).
Contact your doctor if a urine test shows that you have high ketones in the urine.
Even if your blood sugar is normal.
Blood sugar can be affected by stress, illness, surgery, exercise, alcohol use, or skipping meals.
Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia) can make you feel very hungry, dizzy, irritable, or shaky.
To quickly treat hypoglycemia, eat or drink hard candy, crackers, raisins, fruit juice, or non-diet soda.
Your doctor may prescribe glucagon injection in case of severe hypoglycemia.
You may get dehydrated during prolonged illness.
Call your doctor if you are sick with vomiting or diarrhea.
Triplet: ["empagliflozin", "has treatment for severe side effect", "glucagon injection"]

The relation 'has treatment for severe side effect' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has a specific treatment available for the severe side effect described by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'are being treated with': The subject entity is receiving treatment with the substance or therapy specified by the object entity.
D. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
E. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
